description: Just as we can figure things out , so can others. It’s not our job to solve others problems. #designyourlife #PersonalGrowth #selfpresservation
transcript: I no longer live to solve others problems, as a creative, I always have ideas, it's always a, how can I help you with that? What do you need? And within doing that, I've learned that that has been a piece of me trying to control the external world. Just as I can problem solve my own issues and my own things, so can others. We are all more than capable to handle things on our own, and sometimes that does look like seeking out and reaching for help, but most things we can figure solutions out for. And, and learning that, I've become more hands-on with myself because I'm not worried about what's going on in every other space.
